name: PressJunketScheduler
tagline: Talent rotations, approvals and embargoes for every press day – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete publicity desk for press junkets: review outlet requests, approve them, place interviews on a talent rotation grid with drag-and-drop and auto-fill, stop double-bookings, room clashes and missing turnarounds, check journalists in on the day and hold every piece until its embargo lifts. Outlet coverage shows reach by tier and territory.
features: Talent × time rotation grid with drag-and-drop
Clash checks: talent, room, turnaround buffer, talent break, daily cap
